title: 外科医生：AI抢走任务，反而抬高你的价值？
speaker: Alvin Leo

segments.en: Job displacement will happen. It's inevitable when steam power came along, jobs were lost.
segments.zh: 岗位重构会发生。这是不可避免的，蒸汽动力出现时，也有岗位消失。

segments.en: So I think we should assume that, however, that many ways to mitigate that.
segments.zh: 所以我认为我们应该假设这一点，不过有很多方法可以缓解。

segments.en: The way that I like to think about job is that jobs should not be considered as a combination of tasks. And instead, if we think about jobs as purpose driven, then it's different.
segments.zh: 我喜欢这样思考工作：工作不应被视为任务的组合。相反，如果我们把工作视为使命驱动，那就不同了。

segments.en: That's a, my job as a surgeon by training is to advance the health of patients. My task made change over time.
segments.zh: 作为受过训练的外科医生，我的工作是促进患者健康。我的任务会随时间变化。

segments.en: A lot of it will be automated by AI by thinking, if we keep thinking about what is our purpose, AI, it's going to be a tool that can really upskill the workforce.
segments.zh: 很多任务将被AI自动化，但如果我们持续思考我们的使命是什么，AI将成为一个真正能提升劳动力技能的工具。

segments.en: And I think that's a message that needs to be explained to the workforce.
segments.zh: 我认为这是需要向劳动力解释的信息。
